annotations.text:
Mobile header redesign — hamburger + drawer.
The 60px bar carries only the logo and a 44px menu button. Nav (Wishlists / History), language, and account all move into a right-side slide-in drawer, so nothing is cramped and every target is thumb-sized. Matches the app: Fraunces logo, DM Sans, sage accent, 100px pill buttons, modal overlay + shadow tokens.
